$comment: Every SDK maps raw API failures onto this taxonomy. Class names are canonical; languages may adapt the suffix (Error / Exception) but not the hierarchy. `match` describes how to recognize the raw response. The conformance suite in shared/conformance exercises each one. Every error carries baseFields: `operationName` is the GraphQL operation that failed (e.g. AddUserBook), when the request had one.

errors.name: AuthenticationError
errors.notes: Expired, revoked or malformed token, or an anonymous JWT. With a refreshable OAuth token provider, the client refreshes once and replays before surfacing this.

errors.name: ScopeError
errors.notes: body.scope is a SPACE-SEPARATED list of every missing scope (app/api/app/controllers/graphql_controller.rb), e.g. "write:library write:reviews". Split it into missingScopes. The server is authoritative; SDKs never check scopes before sending. Also raised for protected columns (users.email, users.librarian_roles) and protected arguments (review_* fields need write:reviews).

errors.name: UnsupportedOperationError
errors.notes: Operation is blocked for tokens entirely (e.g. update_user, insert_report).

errors.name: RequestTooLargeError
errors.notes: Too many top-level fields in one request. The SDK chunks its own batches to avoid this; users hit it only via the raw escape hatch. Two codes because docs and gateway disagree (spec/06-open-questions.md).

errors.name: RateLimitError
errors.notes: window is 'burst' or 'daily', read from RateLimit headers. A daily exhaustion is not auto-retried.

errors.name: InvalidRequestError
errors.notes: Unparseable query, or a banned filter operator (_like, _ilike, _regex, _similar).

errors.name: GraphQLError
errors.notes: Standard Hasura errors array. data may be partial; the SDK throws by default and exposes partial data on the error.

errors.name: ActionError
errors.notes: Hasura actions return HTTP 200 with a failure inside data. Outputs use either `error: String` (UserBookIdType, SearchOutput, FollowedUserType, TrendingBookType) or `errors: [String]` (ListIdType, GoalIdType, ReadingJournalOutput). Normalize both to messages[].

errors.name: OAuthError
errors.notes: authorization_pending and slow_down are handled inside the device-grant poll loop and never surface.

errors.name: NetworkError

match.client: connection failed or dropped before a response

errors.notes: Mutations are NOT retried on a dropped connection; the write may have landed. Mirrors the app (app/rails/app/javascript/services/UserBookService/verifyThenOfferRetry.ts).
